Name: Trash Can Multi-Open
Description:
[list]
[*]Multi-open for every trash can: applies to all vanilla cans and any mod-added cans with zero setup.[/*]
[*]Adjustable limit: default 4 opens per can per day, configurable from 1 to 99, takes effect immediately.[/*]
[*]Fresh loot every time: each open rolls independently, while loot tables respect each mod's original design.[/*]
[*]Safe and clean: touches nothing but the trash can interaction — no save, map, or item data changes; compatible with all mods.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: 垃圾桶多次打开
Manifest.Description: Lets you check each trash can multiple times per day, with a configurable daily limit.
Manifest.Author: Doubao
